Overview.Name: NagaSrinivas Thota
Overview.Goal: Improve overall energy, reduce cholesterol and liver fat, and enhance body composition while keeping meals satisfying and simple.

Meal_1_Late_Breakfast_or_Brunch: 3 whole eggs cooked in ghee (pan fried or boiled)
1 bowl curd or a glass of buttermilk
1 small bowl rice with cooked vegetables (bottle gourd, ridge gourd, or spinach)
A small serving of fish or chicken (lightly cooked, no spicy gravy)
Meal_2_Evening_or_Early_Dinner: 150–200g grilled chicken, boiled fish, or paneer
1 small bowl rice or vegetable khichdi
Lightly cooked vegetables such as beans, carrots, or snake gourd
Snack_Midday_or_Post_Yoga: Puffed rice or makhana roasted in ghee with salt and pepper

Notes_and_Tips: Focus on liver and cholesterol health — avoid fried foods, spicy biriyani, and packaged snacks. Stick to home-cooked, low-oil meals.
Cook with ghee or butter instead of seed oils.
Limit rice to small portions and pair it with enough protein (eggs, chicken, fish, or paneer).
Avoid skipping meals to prevent overeating later in the day.
Manage social gatherings by eating a light protein-rich meal before attending.
Keep hydration steady throughout the day; plain water and buttermilk are best.
Gentle yoga and short post-meal walks can help relieve back pain and improve digestion.
Over time, this plan will help reduce liver fat, stabilize cholesterol, and give a leaner, more defined look.
